messages:
maya: quick heads-up — console deploy tomorrow might surface a docs regression for dashboard presets. can we do a small PR to 1) rename the cost widget key to cost_breakdown_v2, 2) update the trace_hook example to use the new header format, and 3) fix a couple of broken internal links?

jorge: 👍 on doing a tiny focused PR. what do we want for acceptance criteria? minimal: updated JSON preset, one runnable snippet in python/node, and link fixes.

sam: I can take the SDK snippet updates. will confirm differences for Python vs Node. question: do we need a Rust example too or is a note sufficient?

lee: note for rollout — we should add a backwards-compat blurb: how to map old widget keys to cost_breakdown_v2. customers on older Dedicated can keep using old key until EOL, but we should show a 1-line migration.

maya: add that blurb. keep Rust as a note for now. scope creep = bad here. target is a ~10-line PR.

sam: cool. I'll update the python snippet. prepping a small diff:```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
client.query_dashboard(preset_id="billing_v1", keys=["cost_breakdown_v2"])
```

jorge: I updated the raw dashboard JSON in the branch to rename the key and remove the deprecated metric alias. sample diff in the PR description.

docbot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in docs/observability/presets.md -> /internal/kvcache/guide (404)

maya: thanks docbot. @jorge can you replace that link with /observability/caching/kvcache or add a redirect?

jorge: will add redirect + update the inline reference. also adding brief note about why the key changed (cost aggregation change).

lee: tagging for review: @sam for snippets, @maya for content + migration text, @jorge for preset JSON. can we aim to merge by EOD so QA can smoke test tomorrow?

sam: I can review by 3pm PT. leaving one comment about using the SDK client factory pattern vs direct instantiation. will push small tweak.

maya: great. also, add a single sentence to the changelog entry: "console: migrate dashboard cost widget key to cost_breakdown_v2 (see migration guide)"

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled at 2026-03-23T01:00:00Z — PRs merged before 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z will be included.

sam: merged the snippet changes and fixed the client factory usage. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123 (ready for final content review) :rocket:

maya: I'll do a quick pass now. @lee please add the migration blurb if you can.

lee: added migration blurb, redirect, and a short note about telemetry keys. all pushed.

maya: lgtm. merging after small grammar nitfix.

docbot: link-checker: all links OK for changed files.

maya: merged. tagging release notes and staging smoke test. thanks everyone :tada:
